source_name: NBRSM — Кредитен регистар (Credit Registry)
why_relevant: NBRSM-run credit registry; relevant as a regulator-operated data infrastructure (a system that itself needs vendors) and as a supervisory data source. Not a payments licence register — track at lower priority.

source_name: NBRSM — Финтек-стратегија за финансиски регулатори 2023-2027 (FinTech Strategy for Financial Regulators)
why_relevant: Joint regulators' fintech strategy setting the 2023-2027 agenda (innovation hub/sandbox, open banking, digital payments). Names the initiatives that create vendor demand and the inter-regulator partnerships shaping the payments market.

source_name: NBRSM — Соопштенија / press releases (e.g. Western Balkans payment-system modernisation with Banca d'Italia and ECB, 16 Oct 2025)
why_relevant: Press-release stream is where new licences, system go-lives, instant-payments projects and international partnerships are announced first — the fastest-moving signal layer in this cell, and a direct source of partnership/case-study leads (e.g. regional payment-system modernisation backed by Banca d'Italia/ECB).

source_name: NBRSM — Слободен пристап до информации од јавен карактер (FOI list of information)
why_relevant: Freedom-of-information catalogue enumerating what NBRSM holds and will release on request — a legal fallback route to register/oversight data that is not published in reusable form, and a map of unpublished datasets.

source_name: NBRSM — English mirror of payments section (register + infrastructure pages, -en.nspx)
why_relevant: NBRSM publishes an English mirror on a predictable `-en.nspx` URL pattern. Gives canonical English entity and system names for cross-language entity resolution, though NBRSM states the Macedonian version prevails — so English must never be the sole collection path.

source_name: Komercijalna banka AD Skopje — News / Media Center (Новости и соопштенија)
why_relevant: Largest domestically-owned systemic bank; its newsroom is where new digital channels (new Internet banking, digital card, mBanka features) and any named technology partners are first announced. Domain redirects from kb.com.mk to kb.mk.

source_name: Komercijalna banka AD Skopje — Financial reports / Investor relations
why_relevant: Annual reports and shareholder-assembly materials of a listed bank typically contain an IT/digitalisation chapter and capex commentary — the most reliable public trace of core-system and channel investment.

source_name: Stopanska banka AD Skopje — Годишен извештај (annual report PDFs, /media/ repository)
why_relevant: Full annual business report PDFs (2023, 2024 confirmed in search results) hosted on a predictable /media/<id>/ path; contain the digitalisation/IT-investment narrative and audited financials.

source_name: NLB Banka AD Skopje — Соопштенија за јавност (press release archive)
source_subtype: bank press release archive with year filters
why_relevant: Structured, year-filtered press archive back to 2016 (filters observed for 2016-2026) — the cleanest longitudinal press corpus of any MK bank. Carries launches such as NLB Smart POS (softPOS) and mKlik feature releases, which imply specific technology suppliers.

source_name: NLB Banka AD Skopje — Годишни финансиски извештаи (annual financial reports)
why_relevant: Annual and other financial reports are linked from the About-the-Bank footer navigation; NLB Group subsidiary reporting adds a second, group-level view of IT/digital programmes.

source_name: Halkbank AD Skopje — corporate site / e-banking announcements
source_subtype: bank corporate site / product & news pages
why_relevant: Turkish-owned bank that has publicly positioned itself as a 'complete digital bank' (online account opening, full online service access) — such repositioning normally sits on top of a recent core/onboarding/eKYC procurement.

source_name: Sparkasse Bank Makedonija AD Skopje — Финансиски извештаи
why_relevant: Erste/Steiermärkische subsidiary; annual and audited consolidated reports for 2021-2024 are published here. Group-standard reporting often names platform programmes rolled out from Vienna/Graz.

source_name: ProCredit Bank AD Skopje — corporate site (pcb.mk)
why_relevant: ProCredit Group subsidiary running a 'direct banking' model (heavily self-service, 24/7 zones, card/ATM estate) — a distinctive technology footprint. Note the live domain is pcb.mk, not procreditbank.com.mk.

source_name: Silk Road Bank AD Skopje — Медија (media page)
why_relevant: Dedicated media/news section of a mid-size bank (ex-Ohridska banka, Silk Road Capital owned) that has been rebranding and modernising channels — rebrands are reliable markers of channel/core replacement projects. Also serves srb.mk.

source_name: UNIBanka AD Skopje — corporate site
why_relevant: Mid-size bank in the cell scope; its news and report pages are the direct route to any channel/core announcements. Correct domain confirmed as unibank.com.mk (not uni.com.mk).

source_name: TTK Banka AD Skopje — Извештаи и податоци за Банката
why_relevant: Publishes detailed periodic 'Извештај и податоци за Банката' PDFs (31.12.2024 observed) and corporate-governance codes on a stable /cms/Upload/PDF/ path; also documents its TTK E-bank internet banking product line.

source_name: Centralna kooperativna banka AD Skopje — Извештаи и податоци
why_relevant: Bulgarian CCB-group subsidiary; the reports page carries semi-annual disclosure sets (31.12.2022 through 31.12.2024 observed), the base layer for tracking a smaller bank's IT spend and results.

source_name: SEINet — Electronic information system for listed joint-stock companies (Macedonian Stock Exchange)
source_subtype: regulated disclosure portal / issuer filings aggregator
why_relevant: Mandatory disclosure channel for ~115 listed issuers including Komercijalna, TTK, CKB and other listed MK banks. Price-sensitive announcements, audited annual reports and management statements land here first — a single feed that pointer-routes to every listed bank's filings without crawling each site.

source_name: Macedonian Stock Exchange (Македонска берза) — issuer pages
why_relevant: Per-issuer pages give the canonical legal name, ticker and links to filings for every listed bank — the authoritative actor map and the routing layer into SEINet documents.

source_name: IT.mk — Macedonian technology news portal
why_relevant: Covers the supplier side of MK fintech/banking IT (observed covering the MSE's SEINet iOS app). Useful for catching integrator and vendor names that bank press releases omit.

source_name: Google Play / App Store listings for MK bank mobile apps
why_relevant: App package ids, developer names and release notes reveal the actual mobile-banking supplier even when no press release names one — e.g. NLB mKlik Makedonija ships under an Asseco 'jimba' package namespace. Release notes also date feature/vendor changes precisely.

source_name: National Bank of the Republic of North Macedonia — bank directory / supervision news
why_relevant: Authoritative registry of licensed banks with per-bank pages (a Sparkasse Banka AD Skopje news article page was observed), giving canonical legal names, ownership and the complete population for this cell — the anchor for the actor map and for detecting new/merged entities.

source_name: Bank LinkedIn and Facebook company pages (Komercijalna, NLB, Sparkasse, ProCredit, Halkbank)
why_relevant: Banks post launches, go-lives and partner tags on social before or instead of their newsrooms; LinkedIn also surfaces IT job ads naming specific platforms (a strong, cheap signal of the installed stack and of live projects).

source_name: OpenBankingTracker — Sparkasse Bank Makedonija API/developer profile
why_relevant: Aggregates PSD2/open-banking developer portals per bank; a live developer portal reveals the API gateway/open-banking platform vendor and the bank's integration posture — a technology signal never present in press releases.

source_name: TheBanks.eu — North Macedonia bank profiles
why_relevant: Compact English-language directory of MK banks with ownership and profile pages; useful for cross-checking legal names, owners and English transliterations when building the actor map and de-duplicating aliases.

source_name: Ecommerce4all.mk — E-payment guide (MK/EN)
why_relevant: Bilingual practitioner guide that enumerates which MK banks offer e-commerce acquiring (Stopanska, NLB, Komercijalna among them) and how the payment chain is wired locally — a rare consolidated view of bank-side payment capability and intermediaries.

source_name: KIBS payment services catalogue (услуги — ИНАП, НАПС, КАCheck, ЦР100-ЦР500, РДО)
why_relevant: Granular service catalogue naming the institutional counterparties KIBS integrates with (banks, Central Register of North Macedonia, UJP tax administration, other payment system operators) and the registry services (Unified Register of Transaction Accounts). Reveals integration surface and where third-party tech could be supplied.
